_note: Player tips (ROADMAP M4 session 33). Each tip shows once, the first time its moment comes, while the player's "Show player tips" option is on; tips seen are remembered in the options, not the save. moment: where the game asks for a tip (edit_units_open: Edit Units opens). anchor: the part of the screen the popup points at (recruit_pool: the Recruits list in Edit Units). modes: game modes it shows in (single_map, campaign); missing means all. Tips are offered in this order.

build_squad.text: To begin creating a new squad, drag a leader into an empty slot. To add to a squad, drag any unit into an active squad slot.
